MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The set-screw assortment connects with my recent interest in stocking small fasteners for assembly and repairs.",
    "An assortment of screw sizes feels relevant after my washer and bolt kits, although I would wait for a specific need before choosing SAE set screws."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Heat-shrink tubing, wire connectors and electrical tape assume a wiring project that my recent purchases do not suggest.",
    "Filament, cutting discs, a temperature controller and a compressor valve require equipment or tasks I have not shown a need for.",
    "Trash bags and patching tape do not help with the fastening and hanging tasks reflected in my recent choices."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in a few hardware supplies seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop supply.",
    "A pack of small parts is not enough of a match by itself; wire connectors serve a different purpose from the washers and screws I chose."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Two recent magnetic-hook purchases suggest that hanging items on magnetic surfaces matters to me right now.",
    "My recent screw kit uses metric sizes, so an SAE set-screw kit is only a tentative match and may not fit what I am working on.",
    "I rarely interact without a clear use in mind; a broadly related supply does not give me enough reason to choose it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my fastener interest but expanded it into unrelated supplies instead of staying close to my current fastening and magnetic-hanging needs."
}
